name: Cluster VS Code Remote Tunnel
description: Registers a VS Code Remote Tunnel named for the cluster session, supervised, so the browser is the only client a developer needs (SPEC.md §11.1).

sessionId.description: The cluster session id. The tunnel is named <prefix><sessionId>, matching the SSH alias so one identifier addresses the session on both paths.

namePrefix.description: Rendered from model/policy.toml. Present as an option so the Feature carries no second copy of a model fact.

backoffMaxSeconds.description: Supervisor backoff ceiling. Backoff rather than a tight loop: a tunnel failing because its token expired would otherwise spin against the identity provider.
